tools.name: search_characters
tools.description: Find Unicode characters by name, alias, keyword, codepoint, the character itself, or meaning ("tick" finds ✓, "return key" finds ⏎). Best matches first.

tools.name: get_character
tools.description: Everything about one character: what it is, its name, block, script, category, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and UTF-8/UTF-16 codes, aliases, emoji and Han data, and related characters.

tools.name: list_blocks
tools.description: Every Unicode block that has characters, in codepoint order, with its character count.

tools.name: list_block_characters
tools.description: A Unicode block's characters in codepoint order, 200 at a time. Pass the returned cursor to get the next ones.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Hand-picked sets of characters people use most. Collections: selected (Selected characters).
